result.topic_en: Calculation of an elastic energy-type volume integral (with Lamé-like constants a and b) for a deformation in cylindrical coordinates (x, r) with functions u, ρ, β, followed by the variational (Euler–Lagrange) equations obtained by varying u, ρ cos β and β.
